tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Không có luật phân định: người hòa điểm cùng thắng.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Enter 'Victory points on track' as the VP marker value before final scoring. Cult ranking: all four tracks, ties share the summed points of the tied ranks rounded down (Rulespal rulebook text omits the exact tie rounding; split-floor and the 'must have advanced on the track' condition follow the known rule and BGA summary). Area scoring counts buildings in the largest connected network (indirect adjacency via shipping counts, per known rule, not confirmed in retrieved text). Coin conversion: workers/priests/power value per rulebook appendix (not retrieved), then 1 VP per 3 coins. Town and scoring-tile VPs are included in the track value.
